21.    RESOLUTION Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Carey
                        —




       Cottages, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located southeast of the
       intersection of Grove Drive and Cheyenne Street). (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
                                                                       —




Mr. Segrave moved to adopt with staff recommendations I (a) and (b) and 2 (a) and (b) which
includes acknowledgements of Relief of Access to a street for lots less than 36’ wide (Subdivision
Standards Waiver) and a Reduction in a rear setback (Administrative Adjustment); and Prior to
Recording a 10-foot utility easement be added along Cheyenne Street and a Public access easement
be added along Cheyenne Street for a 6-foot attached sidewalk, seconded by Mr. Laybourn.
Motion carried with Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and Dr. Rinne voting “NO”.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a stall report and Brandon Swain,
developer, provided additional information. Chairman Roybal and committee members Rinne and
Segrave commented on the item.

22.    RESOLUTION Authorizing the Mayor and the City Clerk to sign a Final Plat for Sun
       Rise Hills North Subdivision, 3 Filing, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming.
       (SPONSOR- MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Segrave moved to adopt with staff recommendation to grant the exception to maximum block
size, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried with Dr. Rinne and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and
Mr. Layboum voting “NO”.

Athan Mores, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report. Mark Christensen
and Bruce Perryman, AVI P.C., provided additional information. Tom Cobb, City Engineer, and
Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided information related to drainage and
parking. Committee members Lavbourn, Rinne, and Segrave commented on the item. Public
comments were made by Judy Adam, Rebecca Murchie, and Elizabeth Steeple.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Public Services Committee, the
meeting was adjourned at 1:00 p.m.

Submitted by,



Jennifer McClelland
Executive Assistant to the Cheyenne City Council
